title: Vinyaas components.json
description: Consumer project configuration for installing Vinyaas components. The canonical document is served at /schema/components.json on the registry base URL.

$schema.description: URL of this schema. Init writes it from REGISTRY_BASE_URL. Optional for install behavior.

tsx.description: Emit TypeScript components when true, and JavaScript when false. Defaults to true.

tailwind.description: Styling configuration for the consumer project.

css.description: Global CSS file, relative to the consumer project root. Required.

baseColor.description: Base palette name. Defaults to neutral.

cssVariables.description: Install colors as CSS variables when true. Defaults to true.

aliases.description: Import aliases the CLI uses when writing installed files.

components.description: Import specifier for installed components, such as @/components.

ui.description: Import specifier for UI components, such as @/components/ui.

lib.description: Import specifier for shared library files. Optional.

utils.description: Import specifier for the cn helper, such as @/lib/utils.
